s.note: Baloo shaking fruit down from the trees
s.how: Slice 3 bananas into thick rounds. Dip each halfway into 150g melted dark chocolate, then roll in crushed peanuts mixed with coconut. Lay on a lined tray and freeze for 30 minutes. Serve straight from the freezer on a hot afternoon.

Lay banana leaves on a platter. Pile on wedges of mango, pineapple and papaya with a drained can of lychees. Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with salt mixed with a pinch of chilli. Fit for a king of the ancient ruins.

m.note: Mowgli following the girl to the man village
m.how: Soften grated ginger and garlic in oil, add 2 tsp garam masala and fry a minute. Add 1kg chicken thighs, a can of crushed tomatoes and 400ml coconut milk and simmer 30 minutes. Serve with basmati rice and warm naan.

w.how: Warm 800ml coconut milk with 100g sugar until dissolved. Soak 4 gelatine sheets, squeeze and stir in. Pour into glasses and chill for 4 hours. Top with diced mango and toasted shredded coconut.

d.n: Colonel Hathi's dawn patrol mango lassi
d.note: the elephants marching through the jungle
d.how: Blend the flesh of 2 ripe mangoes with 300g Greek yoghurt, 250ml cold milk, a spoon of sugar and a pinch of cardamom until smooth. Pour over ice in tall glasses. Cool enough for the hottest day in the jungle.
